value.label: Gold Pad Cycle
value.description: Main tank keeps Rakkhat on the active gold pad. When Rakkhat corrupts it blue, the tank rotates clockwise to the next gold pad.

value.label: Backyard Runner Phase
value.description: Six Void Caller shadows appear on the center pad and an assigned runner team enters the backyard to kill the corresponding Void Callers.

evidence.source_name: Xynode Maw of Lorkhaj Guide; ESO achievement data

value.label: Lunar Phase
value.description: After the pad cycle the arena resets for another lap; later cycles add additional pressure such as Dreadstalkers.

value.label: Final Phase
value.description: The Two-Moons Dance achievement explicitly requires forcing Rakkhat into his final phase within two lunar cycles.

value.name: Machine Gun
value.handling: Main tank blocks with focused healing and keeps Rakkhat faced away from the group.

value.name: Jump Knockback
value.handling: Group blocks the jump to avoid being launched into blue pads or cleanse pads.
